title: Integrating Psychometrics and Computing Perspectives on Bias and Fairness in Affective Computing: A Case Study of Automated Video Interviews
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It mentions 'religion or belief' as a protected characteristic under US law where bias can occur, but performs no analysis on this dimension.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned only as an example of a protected characteristic in the context of anti-discrimination law and as a demographic category where human judgment bias can occur. The paper's case study focuses exclusively on gender bias.
